_description: Hand-written mapping from Lexora's 8 clause types to CUAD categories. Used ONLY for runtime precedent retrieval from reference_clauses; the benchmark uses CUAD's native categories and does not read this file. A null entry means no clear CUAD equivalent: precedent search runs unfiltered and is logged. 'loose' lists categories included in 'categories' that are only an approximate match.

Termination.note: Notice Period To Terminate Renewal concerns notice to stop auto-renewal, not termination itself.
